approved: Structured Finance Support (Coronavirus Economic Response Package) Bill 2020
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill is one of several in a package that would put in place the government's announced economic measures to address the coronavirus outbreak.
The package would create new financing and support mechanisms for businesses and regions affected by the pandemic.
The explanatory memorandum does not detail which specific measures this bill alone would introduce.
The package would establish a guarantee for lending to small and medium enterprises.
The package would create an Australian Business Growth Fund.
The package would provide assistance for severely affected regions.
The package would boost cash flow for employers.
The package would make appropriations for the economic response.
The package would set up structured finance support.
Businesses, employers, and regions affected by the coronavirus outbreak.
